gripOrHq.title: Rush Hour
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, access three additional cards from R&D. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

gripOrHq.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: HQ Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

gripOrHq.title: Corolla Speed Chip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Corolla Speed Chip when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using killers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Open-Ended® Mileage Program
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Remove a tag, at no cost. You may pay [1] when you play Open-Ended® Mileage Program to take it back into your hand instead of trashing it.

heapOrArchives.title: Open-Ended® Mileage Program
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Remove a tag, at no cost. You may pay [1] when you play Open-Ended® Mileage Program to take it back into your hand instead of trashing it.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Security Purge
scoreArea.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Reclamation
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

rig.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Big Frackin' Gun
rig.rulesText: [6]: Break up to five sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

root.rulesText: Discard a card at random: Gain [2]. Use this ability only during a run. At the end of the run, return to the bank any of the [2] you did not spend.

root.title: Corporate Shuffle
root.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.
